hero.title: Automotive research & consulting for decisions that carry strategic weight.
hero.content: Since 1992, L+H has supported demanding research and consulting projects in the automotive industry: from volume clinics and design studies to ethnography, online research, and board-ready, condensed results. conclusion.title: When sound decisions require more than just data.
conclusion.paragraph_1: L+H specializes in automotive research and consulting, with many years of experience in complex and sensitive projects. We combine methodological rigor, TISAX (AL-3) certified process quality, and results that hold up even at the management and executive board levels.
conclusion.paragraph_2: With our AI platform, which complies with data protection regulations, we are driving targeted advancements in research processes—for faster analysis, greater precision, and reliable decisions.
